unresolved.note: origenrealty.in gives no possession date. Our '2033' is consistent with the RERA completion date (30 Sep 2033), recorded as reraCompletionDate.
origenrealty.in publishes no price (schema says availability PreOrder, no amount). Leave unpublished.
Builder site does not state a status. The RERA filing gives 'Likely date of starting the construction work 01-10-2026', so 'new launch' may be more accurate than 'under construction'.

Our 478 units / 5 towers is not stated by the builder anywhere; the builder shows only Phase I (2 towers), and RERA registers 344 apartments for it. 478/5 may be a full-masterplan figure from a broker.
The builder's 'Super Built-up Area 2350 sq ft onwards' conflicts with its own Type 2 plan (2,196.52 sq ft super). Builder does not show the separate 3BHK + U / 3BHK + SP sizes individually.
